ladder.label: COUNTER-TREND BOUNCE
ladder.why: Short-term, a daily bottoming setup is forming — but the bigger picture is bearish (weekly momentum negative; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); last cycle left-translated (topped early)). A bounce here is COUNTER-TREND: daily-cycle lows that don't line up with a weekly-cycle low tend to be left-translated and fail, then cascade toward the larger cycle low — exactly the trap of buying a daily low in a falling investor cycle. The daily cycle has already failed (broke its own start low). Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Nimble traders only — small size, tight stop below 1256.0. Not an investment buy; wait for the weekly timeframe to actually turn up (or a fresh investor-cycle low to confirm) before trusting it.

ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum negative; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 19 · failed · daily cycle broke its start low 28d ago).
